top_choice_rationale: The Higgs boson is the clearest case of nature supplying the decisive clue: predicted in 1964, found in 2012 by two independent detectors, and fully mature after a decade of coupling and mass measurements, while the 2013 prize honoured only the theory. P002 applies a statable rule (conception and construction of the instruments in both experiments, citation naming ATLAS and CMS), though the three-for-thousands cut and CMS weighting are real weaknesses. If that leadership rule is judged indefensible, the experimental optical-lattice prize P005 is the mature, settled fallback, ranked above the mixed P004 because the experiments established the field. The twisted bilayer graphene case P003 is too young with an unsettled mechanism, and clocks P001 read more as precision metrology; any award still beats no award.
